name: The Humans Are Deceitful
source:
The humans of your household are cruelly indifferent to your suffering.  As dire as things may be, you will not go down without a fight.

[From [url=https://eldritchpigeon.itch.io/the-humans-are-deceitful]Itch.io[/url]]
